messages:
Maya: AM pulse — quick async standup. What I did: finished the embed-cache spec draft (https://docs.redwood.com/specs/embed-cache). Blockers: need perf numbers and infra signoff. Today: iterate perf appendix and make a priority call for the next ship. Q: do we keep embed-cache as launch priority or move to post-launch? ping @Alex for cost/latency delta.
Alex: Reviewed the spec, looks good. Quick numbers: ~+8% cost, ~-20% tail latency for embeddings-heavy flows. Posted microbenchmarks here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4123. I can try a tighter config to cut cost — need a dev run. @Nate can you spare GPU time?
Nate: I can carve out a 2h dev GPU window tomorrow 10:00–12:00 PT. Blocker: model artifacts need to be in `s3://dev-artifacts/embed-cache/v2` or I can't run the exact same job. Can someone upload the tarball?
Sophia: Design check — UX copy for cache toggle is ready (figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/embed-cache). Tiny ask: we want a feature-flag and an in-console tooltip when toggled on. Will defer copy to final PR.
Ryan: Launch POV: I'd prefer to ship without embed-cache and roll it in as a canary day+1. Fewer things to validate at launch. +1 for gradual rollout.
Maya: OK noted. Quick prioritization test — react with :one: to ship without embed-cache, :two: to ship with embed-cache. Will collect reactions for 2h and make a call.
Alex: pushing a config branch that reduces memory footprint, might make :two: viable. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4128 — includes a small quantization tweak and batching param.
Nate: uploaded artifacts to `s3://dev-artifacts/embed-cache/v2/2026-03-17.tar.gz`. Kicked off a smoke run, logs to /prod/devruns/4123-smoke. If anyone wants access ping me.
Sophia: noted for tooling — if this lands post-launch we should surface a warning about possible cache warmup latency.
DeployBot: Canary scheduled: routing-service v1.9.4 deploy on 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC (automated).
Maya: thanks all — I'll summarize on the decisions board after the reaction window and update the roadmap entry. If :two: gets traction, @Alex please coordinate the dev run results and I'll block time with SRE for a canary.
